recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a male musician in a suit and sunglasses, seated on a stool and playing an acoustic guitar against a deep red velvet stage curtain. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the guitar and the performer's face while casting deep shadows. The composition is framed by vintage-style typography in the upper corners and center-top.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm yellow typography against deep burgundy velvet
Bright acoustic guitar body as the central visual anchor
High-contrast spotlighting creating a moody, intimate atmosphere
Symmetrical balance between corner metadata and central subject
coreInvariants: Acoustic guitar held in a classical seated position

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician is centrally located, medium-full shot, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The light-colored wood of the acoustic guitar body.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright guitar, moves up to the performer's face, then to the stylized title at the top, and finally to the tracklist on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows and dark curtain folds provide significant negative space on the left and right edges.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale Yellow/Cream (Main title and guitar body)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright guitar/text and the low-value, high-saturation red background.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a double-line inline effect
Letters are tightly kerned with some overlapping strokes
Rounded terminals on the display type
Secondary text is clean, high-contrast sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' and 'F' are elongated to create a framing bracket for the rest of the name
Inline yellow strokes within black outlines

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the dark negative space of the curtain

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stylized geometric display paired with functional, neutral grotesque for metadata.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic with inline modification

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, geometric structure of the era

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast photograph of a man in a grey suit and sunglasses playing an acoustic guitar, seated on a stool. The background is a dark red velvet curtain with deep vertical folds. The lighting is a harsh spotlight from the side, leaving half the scene in deep shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large stylized title in the top center using a yellow geometric sans-serif font with a black inline effect. Add a list of song titles in small white sans-serif text on the middle-left side. Place technical metadata in the top-left and top-right corners in white sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the curtain a deep, saturated burgundy?
Does the main title have a yellow inline stroke?
Is the guitar the brightest element in the photograph?
Is the tracklist left-aligned in the negative space?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and track titles
Specific facial features of the performer

mustAchieve: Rich velvet texture in the background
Geometric precision in the display typography
avoid: Contemporary sans-serif fonts like Helvetica or Arial

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast lighting on the subject's face and hands
Ensure the yellow text is legible against the red background
Verify the 'vintage film' look of the photography
Confirm the absence of modern logos
recipe.reuseFormula: Seated musician + acoustic guitar + red velvet curtain + geometric inline typography = Vintage Soul Aesthetic.
